name: Form 3 English: Reported Speech
subject: English
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to change direct speech to reported speech
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to apply correct tense changes in reported speech
learningActivities: Revision: learners identify direct and reported speech
Demonstration: teacher shows how tenses change in reported speech
Guided practice: learners convert sentences to reported speech
Application: learners report conversations from a short dialogue
keyPoints: Direct speech quotes the exact words spoken
In reported speech, the tense usually moves one step back
'I am happy,' said Mary -> Mary said that she was happy
commonMisconceptions: Not changing the tense of the verb
lessonEvaluation: Learners convert sentences to reported speech and report a dialogue.
teacherReflection: Good progress. Emphasise pronoun changes next lesson.
